question: The value of (0.7times 0.7×0.7+0.3×0.3×0.3)/(0.7×0.7-0.7×0.3+0.3×0.3) is ______.
solution:
**Given:**

**(0.7 times 0.7 times 0.7 + 0.3 times 0.3 times 0.3)/(0.7 times 0.7 - 0.7 times 0.3 + 0.3 times 0.3)** = ?

**Formula used:**

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (0.7³ + 0.3³)/(0.7² - 0.7 times 0.3 + 0.3²)

⇒ ((0.7 + 0.3)(0.7² - 0.7 times 0.3 + 0.3²))/((0.7² - 0.7 times 0.3 + 0.3²))

⇒ 0.7 + 0.3

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
